# ShareCapsule

> Public tools and shareable content for media, events, passport photos, news investigation, and technology architecture.

## Tools

- [YouTube to WhatsApp Status Clips](https://sharecapsule.app/tools/whatsapp-share/) — Browser-local splitter for turning a video the user owns into short MP4 clips for WhatsApp Status while preserving a click-through link to the original YouTube video on ShareCapsule.

## Technology

- [Multi-Cloud Challenge: Token-Aware AI](https://sharecapsule.app/technology/tokenawareai/) — A technical article about identity, policy, compliance, observability, and transaction context across hybrid multi-cloud financial systems. Author: Anantha Prakash Nithiyanantham.
